title: Peanuts Woodstock Easter Bunny Outfit Plush, Charlie Brown
descriptionText: The Peanuts Woodstock Character Easter Bunny Outfit Plush is a charming stuffed animal featuring the beloved Woodstock character from the Peanuts franchise. Made of plush material with a multicolor design, this collectible item captures the essence of the TV show and is perfect for fans of the animated series. The Easter bunny outfit adds a festive touch to this adorable and nostalgic piece of animation merchandise.
